question: Did Elsa hunt bowels when she was young as well?
answer: I'm not sure what age you mean when you say 'young', but she began hunting bowels when she was eleven. Until then, she hadn't got as far as hunting bowels. It was soon after she started hunting. One who would endure rather than one who would be revolted, one who would feel nothing rather than one who would endure, one who enjoy it rather than one who would feel nothing, would progress faster. No trouble at all.
